name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | SaaS Retention, Adoption & Expansion | Success Plans, Business Reviews, Salesforce

Owns the strategic relationship for a customer portfolio: builds success plans around their business goals, tracks health and usage to catch risk early, and runs business reviews that show value and surface expansion. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%), onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets, and advised executives at Accelo as a trusted advisor. Works daily in Salesforce and turns usage and performance data into clear recommendations.
